questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «عوارض قلبی عروقی» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Irritable bowel syndrome is defined by recurrent abdominal pain associated with defecation and change in stool frequency or shape, without explanatory structural damage. Warning signs include onset at an advanced age, weight loss, blood, anemia, fever, nocturnal diarrhea, family history of IBD/cancer, and elevated inflammatory markers and require organic investigation. Treatment is with education, soluble fiber such as psyllium, short-term guided low-FODMAP diet, antispasmodic, and subtype therapy; Rifaximin for IBS-D and low-dose TCA are useful in selected pain/IBS-D. questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «مصرف استروژن» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «بیماری کوشینگ» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.

questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. questions.explanation_en: In GI bleeding, first ABC, two IV, type/cross, CBC/coag and resuscitation are performed; Endoscopy is not performed before hemodynamic stabilization. Hematochezia with shock and very high BUN/Cr can be upper GI brisk bleeding, and upper endoscopy is the priority after stabilization. In persistent lower bleeding, colonoscopy after bowel prep; In ongoing brisk bleed, CT angiography and then embolization is useful. A visible hemorrhoid in a person over 45 or with anemia/change bowel habit does not rule out cancer and colonoscopy is necessary. NSAID raises bleeding risk and melena upper source.

questions.explanation_en: CKD is an abnormality of kidney structure or function for more than three months and is classified by cause, GFR and albuminuria. Blood pressure control, ACEI/ARB in appropriate albuminuria, SGLT2 inhibitor, diabetes control and avoidance of nephrotoxin slow progression. Complications include anemia, acidosis, hyperkalemia, CKD-MBD and volume overload. A trended eGFR is more important than a single creatinine. Preparation for kidney replacement should be started before the terminal stage.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «شروع درمان آنتی‌بیوتیکی با آمپی‌سیلین، سفالکسین یا نیتروفورانتوئین» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «شروع درمان آنتی‌بیوتیکی با آمپی‌سیلین، سفالکسین یا نیتروفورانتوئین» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

questions.explanation_en: CKD is an abnormality of kidney structure or function for more than three months and is classified by cause, GFR and albuminuria. Blood pressure control, ACEI/ARB in appropriate albuminuria, SGLT2 inhibitor, diabetes control and avoidance of nephrotoxin slow progression. Complications include anemia, acidosis, hyperkalemia, CKD-MBD and volume overload. A trended eGFR is more important than a single creatinine. Preparation for kidney replacement should be started before the terminal stage.

questions.explanation_en: Nephrotic syndrome includes heavy proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, edema and hyperlipidemia and increases the risk of thrombosis and infection. In adults, diabetes, membranous nephropathy, FSGS and amyloidosis are important. Workup is targeted with urine protein quantification, renal function, serology and sometimes biopsy. Treatment includes control of the cause, RAAS blockade, cautious diuretic, lipid/risk management and selective anticoagulation.

questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

questions.explanation_en: CKD is an abnormality of kidney structure or function for more than three months and is classified by cause, GFR and albuminuria. Blood pressure control, ACEI/ARB in appropriate albuminuria, SGLT2 inhibitor, diabetes control and avoidance of nephrotoxin slow progression. Preparation for kidney replacement should be started before the terminal stage.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

questions.explanation_en: CKD is an abnormality of kidney structure or function for more than three months and is classified by cause, GFR and albuminuria. Blood pressure control, ACEI/ARB in appropriate albuminuria, SGLT2 inhibitor, diabetes control and avoidance of nephrotoxin slow progression. Complications include anemia, acidosis, hyperkalemia, CKD-MBD and volume overload. A trended eGFR is more important than a single creatinine. Preparation for kidney replacement should be started before the terminal stage.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «اسیدوز توبولار کلیوی (Renal Tubular Acidosis - RTA)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «اسیدوز توبولار کلیوی (Renal Tubular Acidosis - RTA)» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. questions.explanation_en: Sodium disorder should be analyzed based on tonicity and volume status; Rapid correction of hyponatremia has the risk of osmotic demyelination. Hyperkalemia is treated with ECG change, first IV calcium, then insulin/glucose and elimination. Hypokalemic hypertension suggests mineralocorticoid excess/Liddle. Mg has an effect on K/Ca. In dysnatremia, urine osmolality and urine sodium are the key mechanisms.

questions.explanation_en: CKD is an abnormality of kidney structure or function for more than three months and is classified by cause, GFR and albuminuria. Blood pressure control, ACEI/ARB in appropriate albuminuria, SGLT2 inhibitor, diabetes control and avoidance of nephrotoxin slow progression. Complications include anemia, acidosis, hyperkalemia, CKD-MBD and volume overload. A trended eGFR is more important than a single creatinine. Preparation for kidney replacement should be started before the terminal stage.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

Creatinine number alone is not enough. In ESRD, vascular access, anemia, CKD-MBD and dialysis dose are monitored. Peritoneal dialysis can cause pleuroperitoneal leak. Medication dosing should be adjusted by modality.

questions.explanation_en: Nephrotic syndrome includes heavy proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, edema and hyperlipidemia and increases the risk of thrombosis and infection. In adults, diabetes, membranous nephropathy, FSGS and amyloidosis are important. Workup is targeted with urine protein quantification, renal function, serology and sometimes biopsy. Treatment includes control of the cause, RAAS blockade, cautious diuretic, lipid/risk management and selective anticoagulation.

questions.explanation_en: Nephrotic syndrome includes heavy proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, edema and hyperlipidemia and increases the risk of thrombosis and infection. In adults, diabetes, membranous nephropathy, FSGS and amyloidosis are important. Workup is targeted with urine protein quantification, renal function, serology and sometimes biopsy. Treatment includes control of the cause, RAAS blockade, cautious diuretic, lipid/risk management and selective anticoagulation.

questions.explanation_en: CKD is an abnormality of kidney structure or function for more than three months and is classified by cause, GFR and albuminuria. Blood pressure control, ACEI/ARB in appropriate albuminuria, SGLT2 inhibitor, diabetes control and avoidance of nephrotoxin slow progression. Complications include anemia, acidosis, hyperkalemia, CKD-MBD and volume overload. A trended eGFR is more important than a single creatinine. Preparation for kidney replacement should be started before the terminal stage.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

Hyperkalemia is treated with ECG change, first IV calcium, then insulin/glucose and elimination. Hypokalemic hypertension suggests mineralocorticoid excess/Liddle. Mg has an effect on K/Ca. questions.explanation_en: CKD is an abnormality of kidney structure or function for more than three months and is classified by cause, GFR and albuminuria. Blood pressure control, ACEI/ARB in appropriate albuminuria, SGLT2 inhibitor, diabetes control and avoidance of nephrotoxin slow progression. Complications include anemia, acidosis, hyperkalemia, CKD-MBD and volume overload. A trended eGFR is more important than a single creatinine. Preparation for kidney replacement should be started before the terminal stage.

questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «پروتئینوری شدید در محدوده نفروتیک به میزان ۴ گرم در ۲۴ ساعت» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.explanation_en: Sodium disorder should be analyzed based on tonicity and volume status; Rapid correction of hyponatremia has the risk of osmotic demyelination. Hyperkalemia is treated with ECG change, first IV calcium, then insulin/glucose and elimination. Hypokalemic hypertension suggests mineralocorticoid excess/Liddle. Mg has an effect on K/Ca. In dysnatremia, urine osmolality and urine sodium are the key mechanisms.

questions.explanation_en: Nephrotic syndrome includes heavy proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, edema and hyperlipidemia and increases the risk of thrombosis and infection. In adults, diabetes, membranous nephropathy, FSGS and amyloidosis are important. Workup is targeted with urine protein quantification, renal function, serology and sometimes biopsy. Treatment includes control of the cause, RAAS blockade, cautious diuretic, lipid/risk management and selective anticoagulation.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «کیست‌های ساده محتوی مایع شفاف بوده و به طور معمول حاوی کلسیفیکاسیون و سپتوم‌های متعدد هستند.» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «کیست‌های ساده محتوی مایع شفاف بوده و به طور معمول حاوی کلسیفیکاسیون و سپتوم‌های متعدد هستند.» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.explanation_en: CKD is an abnormality of kidney structure or function for more than three months and is classified by cause, GFR and albuminuria. Blood pressure control, ACEI/ARB in appropriate albuminuria, SGLT2 inhibitor, diabetes control and avoidance of nephrotoxin slow progression. Complications include anemia, acidosis, hyperkalemia, CKD-MBD and volume overload. A trended eGFR is more important than a single creatinine. Preparation for kidney replacement should be started before the terminal stage.

questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «به شکل درب تابوت با منشورهای مستطیلی (Coffin-lid appearance)» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.explanation_en: Acid-base interpretation is done with pH, PaCO2, HCO3, compensation and anion gap. Winter formula for metabolic acidosis and delta gap indicates mixed disorder. normal-gap acidosis is from diarrhea or RTA and high-gap is from lactate, ketoacids, renal failure and toxins. Urine anion gap helps in differentiating GI bicarbonate loss from RTA. The treatment of the cause precedes the correction of the number and bicarbonate is given only in the appropriate indication.

Hyperkalemia is treated with ECG change, first IV calcium, then insulin/glucose and elimination. Hypokalemic hypertension suggests mineralocorticoid excess/Liddle. Mg has an effect on K/Ca. In dysnatremia, urine osmolality and urine sodium are the key mechanisms.

questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

Hyperkalemia is treated with ECG change, first IV calcium, then insulin/glucose and elimination. Hypokalemic hypertension suggests mineralocorticoid excess/Liddle. Mg has an effect on K/Ca. In dysnatremia, urine osmolality and urine sodium are the key mechanisms.

questions.explanation_en: Sodium disorder should be analyzed based on tonicity and volume status; Rapid correction of hyponatremia has the risk of osmotic demyelination. questions.explanation_en: AKI is defined by an increase in creatinine or a decrease in urine and is divided into prerenal, intrinsic and postrenal. First, the volume, nephrotoxic drugs, urinalysis/sediment and obstruction are evaluated. FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

Creatinine number alone is not enough. In ESRD, vascular access, anemia, CKD-MBD and dialysis dose are monitored. Peritoneal dialysis can cause pleuroperitoneal leak. Medication dosing should be adjusted by modality.

FENa is limited in diuretic/CKD and FEUrea is sometimes helpful. muddy brown casts refer to ATN, RBC casts to glomerulonephritis and WBC casts to interstitial nephritis/pyelonephritis. Treatment of the cause is drug and fluid adjustment, K/acid-base monitoring and dialysis in AEIOU.

questions.question_fa: تجویز داروی ضدالتهاب غیراستروئیدی (NSAID) در کدامیک از بیماران زیر، با ریسک بسیار کمتری از نظر ایجاد آسیب حاد کلیوی همودینامیک (Hemodynamic AKI) همراه است؟
questions.question_en: Prescribing non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) in which of the following cases there is a lower risk of causing acute kidney failure?
options_fa: آقای ۶۰ ساله‌ای با سابقه سیروز پیشرفته کبدی و آسیت
خانم ۴۸ ساله‌ای با ۳ روز اسهال و استفراغ شدید و دهیدراتاسیون
آقای ۳۸ ساله سالم بدون بیماری زمینه‌ای با درد حاد کمر ناشی از اسپاسم عضلانی
خانم ۳۰ ساله‌ای مبتلا به نارسایی احتقانی پیشرفته قلب (CHF)
options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «آقای ۶۰ ساله‌ای با سابقه سیروز پیشرفته کبدی و آسیت» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «خانم ۴۸ ساله‌ای با ۳ روز اسهال و استفراغ شدید و دهیدراتاسیون» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.

صحیح است؛ «آقای ۳۸ ساله سالم بدون بیماری زمینه‌ای با درد حاد کمر ناشی از اسپاسم عضلانی» منطبق بر رفرنس رسمی (اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش بیماری‌های کلیه، مجاری ادراری و الکترولیت‌ها)، پاسخ صحیح و مسیر بالینی استاندارد است.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «خانم ۳۰ ساله‌ای مبتلا به نارسایی احتقانی پیشرفته قلب (CHF)» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.
questions.explanation_fa:
تحلیل بالینی و صورت مسئله: در این سناریو، بیمار با تظاهرات «تجویز داروی ضدالتهاب غیراستروئیدی (NSAID) در کدامیک از بیماران زیر، با ریسک بسیار کمتری از نظر ایجاد آسیب حاد کلیوی همودینامیک (Hemodynamic AKI) همراه است؟» در حیطه تخصصی کلیه تحت ارزیابی قرار گرفته است. با استناد به مبانی تشخیصی و تصمیم‌گیری بالینی مرجع کانونی اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش بیماری‌های کلیه، مجاری ادراری و الکترولیت‌ها، اقدام انتخابی و پاسخ صحیح بالینی «آقای ۳۸ ساله سالم بدون بیماری زمینه‌ای با درد حاد کمر ناشی از اسپاسم عضلانی» می‌باشد.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «آقای ۳۸ ساله سالم بدون بیماری زمینه‌ای با درد حاد کمر ناشی از اسپاسم عضلانی» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «آقای ۳۸ ساله سالم بدون بیماری زمینه‌ای با درد حاد کمر ناشی از اسپاسم عضلانی» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
